index.note: Flow opens on what InSite was and how it told stories, then four chapters that are also the four section titles, one per kind of story; the closing keeps the call on the magazine side and the three templates.
index.stand: InSite was the editorial hub on the Neiman Marcus website, and it told fashion stories the way a magazine would. | It had to sell product like a store at the same time.
abs: On every InSite piece, the concept came first, then the shoot, then the styling and the layout. All of the photography was shot in the studio.

InSite's spotlights introduced emerging.t: InSite's spotlights introduced emerging designers to a broader luxury shopper,
InSite's spotlights introduced emerging.g: and the type did the job a feature profile would have done in print
li: The name | set as big as the photographs, with every spread built around it.
The frame | torn edges, with letters locked into the model's figure.
Shoppers | reached the product page having read something first.

Every InSite shoot was on seamless paper.t: Graphic color blocks stood in for the places a bigger production would have flown to,
Every InSite shoot was on seamless paper.g: because there was no location budget
li: The stories | included Hot Pink, Yellow, Rainbow, Orange and Coral.
Chip grids | stepped through each story's tones.
Pixelated | on purpose, because InSite lived on a screen.

Each story's concept set its type.t: Each story's concept set its type,
Each story's concept set its type.g: so the photographer's brief carried its scale, weight and position
li: Restrained stories | Minimalism and Structure set thin, ghosted letters that nearly dissolved.
Loud stories | The Rocker, The Socialite and Classic Beauty wrapped oversized display serifs into the model's silhouette.

Each ways-to-wear spread wrote the outfi.t: Ways-to-wear spreads wrote each outfit as an equation on one grid,
Each ways-to-wear spread wrote the outfi.g: so merchandising could ship new photography without a custom layout
li: Plus signs | set oversized between the pieces.
Speed lines | drawn behind the models gave a flat studio shot some motion.
The layout | figure on one side, type on the other and the equation stacked vertically, and it never moved.

decks.InSite's spotlights introduced emerging: Each designer's name ran in oversized serifs: Theyskens' Theory, Rag & Bone, 10 Crosby Derek Lam, Helmut Lang and Kelly Wearstler.
decks.Every InSite shoot was on seamless paper: Fields of pixelated color set the mood when a sunset wasn't an option.
decks.Each story's concept set its type: A restrained story got a still pose on flat gray paper, and a loud one got a pose with room for a letter to sit across the shoulder.
decks.Each ways-to-wear spread wrote the outfi: A black dress was paired with a denim jacket, then with an ikat sweater, and a silk blouse was styled the same two ways.
decks.Every InSite layout was a call: The store side still had to be findable.
